top_signals.title: Dell surges 5% after lifting fiscal 2027 forecast on AI server strength
top_signals.summary: Dell sees AI server revenue tripling in fiscal 2027. Six months ago, it was looking for the number to double.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
